item.title: Capital City Classic for girls flag football kicks off in Tallahassee Friday
item.description: The 15th annual Capital City Classic is underway at FSU with 26 girls flag football teams competing. Championship games are set for Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Black Family Wellness Expo connects Tallahassee residents with health screenings and education
item.description: This is the 3rd annual event hosted by The Tallahassee chapter of The Links Incorporated in partnership with FAMU Developmental Research School.

item.title: Community members hold march in Tallahassee for International Women's Day on Sunday
item.description: Organizers say the mission of the march was to advocate for women's rights, immigration protection, and political activism.
